state.instructions: Compare two app-source designs without assuming either is already safe or executable.
state.facts: The exact CanBook book operation appears below, preserving its by expression and every guard. Requirement: appointments differ from monetary workspace reservations while their rooms use CanRent as the sole resource capacity owner. Both must apply window/buffer/repair/physical occupancy limits. Neither synthetic payment nor enlarged commercial viewing is allowed for appointment success. Existing Booking stores mandatory customer/account/email, immutable prices/policy, payment and allowance outcomes with own/manager/reception policies. Current RoomsV1 hold/confirm/move/release interface lacks provider ingress.

representation.instructions: Select the better way to represent an appointment room claim under these constraints.

criteria.venue: Declare VenueReservation alongside Booking beneath Resource; retain claim correlation, revision, span, seat quantity and lifecycle, omitting monetary fields. One availability decision counts both models under one owner and role-specific reads. Extra model/query work is the cost; semantic separation prevents misleading payment records.
criteria.tagged: Use purpose=appointment in the existing Booking model. The verified appointment service may confirm the noncommercial purpose with explicit distinct evidence, not a fake paid event. Model reuse reduces record types but makes mandatory fields, commercial history and read/access permissions purpose-dependent.
